effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Omnimon] in its text and 1 card with the [CS] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
